ideas.title: Add shooting star particles
ideas.description: Random shooting stars that streak across the sky with trailing particles. Triggered every 8-15 seconds.

ideas.title: Interactive constellation drawing
ideas.description: Users can click stars to draw constellation lines. Lines glow and fade. Store in localStorage.

ideas.title: Moon phase API integration
ideas.description: Replace calculated moon phase with real astronomical data. Show accurate phase for current date.

ideas.title: Ambient music generator
ideas.description: Procedural ambient music using Web Audio API. Flute-like tones that respond to scroll position and time of day.
ideas.cancelledReason: Audio deliberately removed from site (see idea-014). Conflicts with site direction.

ideas.title: Sunflower field parallax
ideas.description: Multi-layer parallax for sunflower field. Foreground flowers sway more, background less. Depth-based blur.

ideas.title: Philosophy quote carousel
ideas.description: Auto-rotating quote cards with fade transitions. Each quote tied to current section's visual element.

ideas.title: GLSL watercolor post-processing
ideas.description: Add watercolor-style post-processing shader. Edge detection + color bleeding for painterly look.
ideas.cancelledReason: Post-processing pipeline removed in code architecture refactoring (idea-024). Would need to re-implement EffectComposer first.

ideas.title: Daily generated philosophy facts
ideas.description: Use Hermes agent to generate new philosophy facts weekly. Store in siteData.json via cron job.

ideas.title: Loading Optimizations
ideas.description: Astro-native loading optimizations: client:idle hydration, inline critical CSS, modulepreload, progressive 3D layers, content-visibility, SVG compression, Nginx caching+gzip, reduced geometry, loader progress bar. v2 PRD with Astro-compatible patterns.

ideas.title: Flute click — SVG bansuri + music notes
ideas.description: Click anywhere spawns an animated Krishna's bansuri (bamboo flute) SVG at cursor position with floating music note symbols (♪♫♬). Flute animates in/out with spring easing.

ideas.title: White 3D moon + glow
ideas.description: Change 3D moon material from yellow (0xfff8e7) to white (0xffffff) with reduced emissive. Glow sphere also white instead of warm yellow.

ideas.title: Diverse colorful tulips
ideas.description: Replace all-yellow tulip palette with 16 diverse colors (red, orange, pink, magenta, purple, golden, amber, coral, crimson, orchid, vermillion, rose, violet, peach). Each tulip randomized with per-petal variation.

ideas.title: Mobile tulip visibility fix
ideas.description: Tulips were invisible on mobile due to small scale (0.5-0.9), low Y position (-0.5), and narrow aspect ratio. Fixed with larger scale (0.8-1.4), higher Y (-0.1), wider aspect (1.0×1.6).

ideas.title: Remove speaker/audio toggle
ideas.description: Remove the audio toggle button (🔇) from BaseLayout and ambient-audio.js script tag. Flute click + notes remain intact.

ideas.title: ASCII moon brightness + shadow
ideas.description: Lighten ASCII moon text color from #c9a84c to #e8d48a with stronger text-shadow glow. Reduce moon shadow overlay opacity from 0.88 to 0.72.

ideas.title: Glitch shader fix
ideas.description: Fix glitch shader R/B channel swap bug (was reading .b for both r and b). Scope chromatic aberration to glitch lines only (~2% per scanline) instead of every frame.

ideas.title: Blue color cast removal
ideas.description: Remove blue point light washing out scene. Change from 0x4466aa to warm 0xffeedd at lower intensity. Reduce Van Gogh shader saturation from 1.4 to 1.0.

ideas.title: Single-layer flower rendering
ideas.description: Replace 3-layer parallax flower system with proven single-layer approach (a0ce3ef reference). Larger scales, higher Y, correct counts (10 sunflowers, 6 tulips desktop; 6 sunflowers, 3 tulips mobile).

ideas.title: Realistic randomized tulips
ideas.description: Replace abstract oval tulip shapes with realistic cup/bloom forms. 12 non-yellow colors (red, pink, purple, magenta, coral, orange, rose, violet, etc.). Per-tulip randomization: petal count 5-7, width/height variation, curl factor. Petal gradients, edge highlights, vein lines.

ideas.title: Scroll-driven starry night sky parallax
ideas.description: The sky subtly rotates and shifts based on scroll position. Stars at different depths move at different speeds. Moon rises as you scroll. Background color shifts with scroll.

ideas.title: Van Gogh painting gallery carousel
ideas.description: Interactive gallery section showcasing Van Gogh's famous paintings with lazy-loaded images from Wikimedia Commons, themed descriptions, and swipe navigation.
ideas.cancelledReason: User requested removal. Gallery component, gallery.json, and all references deleted. Do NOT re-implement.

ideas.title: Impressionist brushstroke cursor trail
ideas.description: Custom cursor that leaves painterly brushstroke trails using Canvas 2D particle system. Colors sampled from current theme palette. Respects prefers-reduced-motion.

ideas.title: Three.js 3D geometry for all scene elements
ideas.description: Convert all canvas-texture sprites to proper Three.js 3D geometry: sunflowers (TubeGeometry stem + disk + 36 petals in 3 layers), lilies (trumpet petals + 6 stamens with anthers + pistil + spots), music notes (sphere head + cylinder stem + cone flag). Moon upgraded with dual glow spheres. All elements use MeshStandardMaterial with emissive for self-illumination. Billboard heads face camera via lookAt in animate loop.

ideas.title: Code architecture refactoring
ideas.description: Extracted 29KB CSS from BaseLayout to external main.css. Extracted changelog JS and moon-phase JS to external files. Converted 5 duplicated section blocks to data-driven loop. Removed 21 dead files (Three.js component files, shader modules, stale tests). Removed post-processing pipeline (EffectComposer + Van Gogh + Glitch shaders). Added modulepreload for Three.js CDN. HTML inline CSS reduced from 45KB to 2KB.

ideas.title: 3D Cypress Tree Silhouettes
ideas.description: Tall, dark cypress tree silhouettes rendered as Three.js ExtrudeGeometry that sway gently in the background, evoking Van Gogh's iconic Starry Night cypresses. 5 trees on desktop, 2 on mobile. MeshBasicMaterial for zero lighting cost. Integrates with existing parallax scroll system.

ideas.title: Interactive Firefly Swarm
ideas.description: A swarm of 3D firefly points (40 desktop, 20 mobile) that drift organically using damped random walk velocity fields. Each firefly pulses with warm golden light via custom shader. Fireflies scatter away from mouse cursor within 3-unit radius and slowly return. Additive blending for ethereal glow.

ideas.title: Scroll-Driven Painting Reveal
ideas.description: A large Van Gogh painting (loaded from Wikimedia Commons) displayed on a Three.js PlaneGeometry that progressively reveals based on scroll position. Custom shader divides the image into horizontal bands with slight horizontal variation for organic reveal. 150vh scroll section drives the effect.

ideas.title: Theme Color Scheme Switcher
ideas.description: A floating theme picker that lets visitors manually switch between the 5 impressionist color schemes (starry-night, sunflower, midnight-wave, tulip-garden, moonlit-silver). Orphaned PRD from earlier generation — needs review before implementation.

ideas.title: Scroll-Responsive Brushstroke Sound Effects
ideas.description: Generative brushstroke sound effects that play in response to scroll velocity. NOTE: Audio was deliberately removed from the site (see idea-014). This idea conflicts with that direction — flagged for rethink.
ideas.cancelledReason: Conflicts with site direction — audio was deliberately removed (idea-014). Would need to be re-scoped as visual-only brushstroke feedback to be viable.

ideas.title: Van Gogh Biography Timeline
ideas.description: An interactive, scrollable timeline of Van Gogh's life milestones — birth, key paintings, moves, and legacy — displayed as a horizontal card carousel with date markers. Orphaned PRD from earlier generation.

ideas.title: Dynamic Time-of-Day Atmosphere System
ideas.description: The 3D scene subtly shifts its ambient atmosphere based on the visitor's local time — warm golden dawn, bright midday, rich sunset tones, or deep night. Background, stars, moon, waves, and flower colors all respond to time-of-day with smooth interpolation between phases.

ideas.title: Interactive Starry Night Painting Explorer
ideas.description: A zoomable, interactive deep-dive into The Starry Night with clickable hotspot zones over key elements (cypress, moon, village, stars). Each hotspot reveals technique details, symbolism, and relevant Van Gogh quotes. Pinch-to-zoom on mobile, scroll-to-zoom on desktop.

ideas.title: Impressionist Visitor Guestbook
ideas.description: A lightweight, localStorage-backed guestbook where visitors leave short impressions (max 140 chars) that appear as floating, brushstroke-styled text sprites in the 3D scene. Entries persist across visits. No backend — purely client-side.

ideas.title: Wind-Swept Wheat Field
ideas.description: A field of golden wheat stalks rendered as InstancedMesh in the lower 3D scene, swaying organically in a procedural wind vertex shader. 800 stalks desktop / 300 mobile. Scroll position modulates wind intensity. Evokes Van Gogh's iconic wheat field paintings.

ideas.title: Particle Poetry Scroll Effect
ideas.description: As visitors scroll through content sections, key words from headings and intros emerge as 3D CanvasTexture sprites that float upward and fade. Each section has a themed word pool. 25 sprites desktop / 12 mobile. Purely visual — no audio.

ideas.title: Seasonal Scene Transitions
ideas.description: The 3D scene's color palette, flower emphasis, and atmospheric tone shift based on the current calendar season (spring/summer/autumn/winter). Implemented as a content/data layer — daily-mutate.js uses weighted seasonal selection for color schemes and flower ratios. No scene-init.js changes.

ideas.title: Starry Night Swirling Sky Shader
ideas.description: Add noise-based vertex displacement to the sky dome to create authentic swirling brushstroke patterns reminiscent of Van Gogh's Starry Night painting. NOTE: Must be implemented as standalone module, not direct scene-init.js modification.

ideas.title: Detailed Moon Surface with Craters and Texture
ideas.description: Enhance the 3D moon with realistic crater texture, bump mapping, and subtle surface details using normal maps or height maps.

ideas.title: Enhanced Star System with Temperature-Based Colors
ideas.description: Enhance the star field with scientifically-inspired color variations based on simulated star temperatures, creating a more vivid and impressionist night sky.

ideas.title: Aurora Borealis Sky Band
ideas.description: A subtle, shimmering aurora borealis band that ripples across the upper sky dome during night time-of-day phases. Custom GLSL shader with flowing green/blue/purple bands, additive blending, mobile-optimized. NOTE: Depends on idea-032 (time-of-day) which is currently rolled back.

ideas.title: Interactive Flower Pollination Effect
ideas.description: Click on any sunflower or tulip in the 3D scene to release a burst of golden pollen particles. Nearby flowers briefly glow in response. Raycasting click detection with physics-based particle system.

ideas.title: Daily Zen Koan Content Section
ideas.description: A new content section displaying a daily rotating zen koan or philosophical riddle as an elegant calligraphy-styled card. Hold-to-reveal interpretation. Purely content-driven, no scene-init.js changes.

ideas.title: Comet with Particle Trail
ideas.description: A majestic comet with glowing particle trail that slowly crosses the 3D sky every 3-5 minutes. Distinct from shooting stars: larger, slower (30-60s crossing), rare (3-5 min intervals), persistent fading trail. Evokes Van Gogh's Starry Night cosmic energy. NOTE: Requires refactoring to standalone module before implementation.

ideas.title: Van Gogh Letter Excerpts
ideas.description: A new content section featuring daily rotating excerpts from Van Gogh's letters to Theo, rendered as aged-paper styled cards. 800+ letters reveal the artist's philosophy, struggles, and vision. Purely content-driven, no scene-init.js changes.

ideas.title: Village Street Lamp Lights
ideas.description: Warm glowing orbs positioned along the horizon line, representing the village lights from Van Gogh's Starry Night. Gentle pulsing animation, warm gold/amber colors, positioned behind cypress trees. Pure atmospheric addition.
